li.label: the warlord is finished
li.description: The warlord who had the colony on a list is finished. I've stopped listening for horses on the road at night.

li.label: the warlord paid for it
li.description: The warlord whose raiders hurt me has paid for it. I still have the scar. It aches less.

li.label: brought down the warlord
li.description: I brought the warlord down myself. People in towns I've never seen will be telling that story.

li.label: the warlord got away
li.description: The warlord whose raiders hurt me just rode off somewhere with a few friends. No reckoning, nothing.

li.label: the warlord was ransomed
li.description: We had the warlord in a cell, after what those raiders did to me, and sold the key back for silver.

li.label: the warband broke up
li.description: The warband that was coming for us has broken up. The roads will be safer for a while.

li.label: we stood by our neighbors
li.description: When things were bad for the neighbors, the colony helped. I'm glad we're that kind of place.

li.label: my advice went to the sick
li.description: Healers I've never met are using my notes on the sick right now. Some of those people will live because of it.

li.label: the locusts took the crops
li.description: All that work in the fields, and the swarm stripped it in an afternoon.

li.label: peace made at our table
li.description: Two peoples ended a war at our table. Years from now, someone will point at it.

li.label: pilgrims singing at night
li.description: The pilgrims camped by the water sing every night. I don't know the words, but I listen until they stop.

li.label: blessed by the pilgrims
li.description: The pilgrims blessed the colony on their way home. Whatever it's worth, it was kindly meant.

li.label: won at the great fair
li.description: I beat the best the whole region had, in front of everyone. I still have the prize where I can see it.

li.label: lost at the fair
li.description: I wasn't the best at the fair. Close, but not the best. Next year.

li.label: the famous healer mended me
li.description: I'd stopped expecting anyone to fix it. Then the healer came, and now I keep testing it to make sure it's real.

li.label: watched a master healer work
li.description: I watched the famous healer work, up close. I learned more in one evening than in the last year.

li.label: shaken by the surge
li.description: Something answered me out at the stones. I don't want to talk about it yet.
